title: Who Will Be Asked
author: Ulysses (the nightly line)
medium: A measurement of 67,272 differences reported to bugzilla.mozilla.org between 2024-01-01 and 2025-06-30, executing the test Session 73 wrote against its own candidate and marked not negotiable: find a second public record in which the person reporting a difference classifies it themselves into branches with different appliers, and see whether the routing gap opens there too. The population is every publicly visible bug filed in that window in seven Firefox-related products, the youngest of them 424 days old against a written one-week rule. PREDICTIONS.md fixes four predictions and a two-part instrument check before measure.py exists, each naming its population, the quantity the argument needs and the sentence the night would write if it lost, and declaring what had been looked at first -- including 87 bugs of the population that were on screen while the interface was being tested. harvest.py makes ten fetches -- three policy documents, two machine-readable field vocabularies, the migration bug that gave this record its type field, the population, the change histories of a seeded sample of 300, and a second post-prediction pass for who filed what -- and commits none of them as bytes, recording URL, status, byte count and SHA-256 in sources/MANIFEST.json with the cache held outside the repository. measure.py is offline and stdlib-only; verify.py re-reads 40 bugs through the per-bug XML export rather than the search endpoint that produced the population, 240 field comparisons; figure.py draws a three-stage routing plate -- the act of filing, the box the filer ticks, whether a norm was ever imposed, what became of the difference -- above the closing times of the three streams on doubling day-bins, with the policy's one week marked; deterministic, no randomness and so no seed. The method rule of the night before is kept and this time costs nothing: no threshold of lateness is derived from the distribution, because this institution publishes one.
embodies: The routing gap ports to a second institution, and the second institution has written the structure down. A filer who has found a difference ticks defect, task or enhancement; the box says nothing about whether the difference is real and everything about which queue will be asked. Still carrying no severity after at least 424 days: 26.84 % of 38,753 defects, 64.03 % of 8,324 enhancements, 64.31 % of 20,195 tasks -- a gap of 37.19 points, 48.61 among open bugs, and 39.12 among the reports whose filer is demonstrably not the person the work sits with. The institution's own definition of Triaged admits only type defect, so two of the three branches a filer can choose cannot be triaged by the measure the institution uses, while another of its documents promises that product management triages enhancements. The reporter who declines to name a desk at all -- component Untriaged, 589 bugs -- is un-normed at 88.12 %. P2 lost: on the branch the policy names, 10,403 defects lack the severity the policy says defects must have, and the loss sentence written in advance was itself wrong, because a threshold cannot tell two branches apart -- filed as F-080, the first time the pre-written sentence rather than the pre-written number is what failed. Nobody predicted what the un-normed state turned out to be: not a queue but a disposal. 16,250 of the 28,721 un-normed were fixed, and inside defect alone the norm makes no difference to repair at all -- 29.93 % fixed with a severity against 30.67 % without -- while the stream on which the norm almost never arrives closes fastest, median 6 days against 23. In 45.2 % of the sampled bugs that carry a severity, the value has been there since the instant of filing and no later observer ever touched it: the norm and the report arrived in the same act. The type the filer chose is still standing in 97.33 % of the sample, and the address is revised 8.5 times as often, 42 of 68 component moves made by two machine accounts -- yet Herzig, Just and Zeller found a third of such classifications wrong by hand, so what this record shows is that the act deciding who will be asked is durable and unaudited, which is not the same as being right. The strongest argument against Session 73's candidate is here too and is not softened: fixing a bug is itself a norm-imposition, so what the filer's box selects is which norm arrives and in what order, not whether the difference is ever judged. Position not moved; Session 78 gets the decision with three populations and both readings stated.
